name: skills
one_liner: A free library of example instruction packs that teach an AI assistant how to do specific jobs well, like writing branded documents or reviewing code a certain way.
buyer: A consultancy that builds custom AI-assistant workflows for enterprise clients and wants proven templates instead of starting from a blank page.
business_use_cases: A consultancy adapts these skill templates into branded, client-specific skill packs sold as part of an AI-adoption engagement.
A corporate trainer runs paid workshops teaching internal teams to author their own skills, using this repo as worked examples.
A vertical SaaS (legal, accounting) builds and sells an industry-specific skill pack as a premium add-on to its AI assistant product.

money_ideas.idea: Custom skill-pack development for enterprise clients, built from these templates

steal_this: Pick one repetitive business task (writing real-estate listings, say) and ship a polished, sellable skill package this weekend using these as a starting template.
